ValidationRule.description: Ticket sales must open before start and close before end.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Sales_Open_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_At__c)), Sales_Open_At__c > Start_At__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Sales_Close_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_At__c)), Sales_Close_At__c > End_At__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Ticket sales must open and close inside the event itself — stop selling once the doors are open.
